items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] We had a feud going, he and I. ... [INTERVIEWER] ... that was in the Luis Russell band. [INTERVIEWEE] But I was in the Luis Russell band too.

ctx.x: I remember Greeley (phonetic spelling) said he got fired, he was one of the first guys to get fired out of that band; that was during the time that you were there.
Yeah, Greeley was there. Red Allen was there a long time after I left. He wasn't there when I first got there.
No, no, when you first got there, it was Gus Aiken and Ham.
